title: A second new game in one session keeps the old clothes colour
details: (Found in the 2026-09-26 code review, owner asked for all of these to be fixed) BootScene and the bus scene reuse cached `player`/`player-bus` textures, so a different colour chosen later is ignored.

thread.author: agent
thread.text: A new game with a different clothes colour now shows the new colour.

resolution.test: tests/e2e/intro.spec.js › FB-0038: a second new game with a different clothes colour replaces the old sprite sheet
